purpose: V-Dem country units (and LIED/BMR units outside the country crosswalk) -> Wikidata QIDs, per V-Dem historical-name period, so politics atlas rows of historical states link to KG entities. Never changes an iso3.
rules: a period gets a QID only when its exact V-Dem histname names the state of that Wikidata item (or a listed agent decision); occupation periods, annexations, colonies and ambiguous names stay null

every QID was checked against the Wikidata entity (label, description, inception/dissolution): fetched by A-POL with wbgetentities through the WDHARVEST locked client, or reused from A-HISTECON's verified file (see evidence)
crosswalk countries get their QID from WDHARVEST's registry/entities/country_qids.json via iso3; this file does not duplicate it
atlas rows: entity_qid = QID of the V-Dem period containing the row's year, else the unit qid, else null
